svg.title: Unemployment rates for young workers and college graduates
svg.desc: Line chart showing unemployment rates for young workers, recent graduates, and college graduates from 1990 through 2026, with a marker for ChatGPT's November 2022 release.
svg.text: Source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates; CPS (IPUMS). Updated May 5, 2026.
